description: This Java class defines a custom Android view 'CardView' that extends ImageView, enabling flip and rotation animations for card-like UI elements, including front/back bitmap management, flip animations, rotation around corners, and shadow effects.

classes.name: CardView
classes.description: A custom ImageView that supports flipping and rotating animations for card-like UI elements, managing front/back bitmaps, flip animations, corner rotations, and shadow effects.

classes.name: Corner
classes.description: Enumeration representing the four corners of the card: TOP_LEFT, TOP_RIGHT, BOTTOM_LEFT, BOTTOM_RIGHT.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the CardView, setting camera distance and loading front/back bitmaps with borders.

methods.name: bitmapWithBorder
methods.description: Creates a bitmap with a 1-pixel transparent border for anti-aliasing during rotation.

methods.name: flipRightToLeft
methods.description: Starts a flip animation from right to left.

methods.name: flipLeftToRight
methods.description: Starts a flip animation from left to right.

methods.name: flipHorizontally
methods.description: Performs a horizontal flip animation, updating the front/back display and layout.

methods.name: setShadow
methods.description: Darkens the image to simulate a shadow effect based on a float value.

methods.name: toggleFrontShowing
methods.description: Switches the front/back bitmap being displayed.

methods.name: toggleIsHorizontallyFlipped
methods.description: Flips the horizontal state of the view and invalidates for redraw.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Updates the horizontal flip matrix when the view size changes.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the view, applying horizontal flip if needed.

methods.name: updateLayoutParams
methods.description: Resets layout parameters to maintain position after rotation.

methods.name: updateDrawableBitmap
methods.description: Updates the displayed bitmap to front or back.

methods.name: updateTranslation
methods.description: Sets translation based on position in a pile.

methods.name: getRotationAnimator
methods.description: Returns an animator for rotating the card around a corner, with direction and out/in options.

methods.name: getFullRotationAnimator
methods.description: Returns an animator for a full 360-degree rotation around a corner, with delay based on position.

methods.name: rotateCardAroundCorner
methods.description: Sets pivot points for rotation based on specified corner.

methods.name: setCardFlipListener
methods.description: Assigns a listener for flip start/end events.
